name: io.github.patsa2561-art/mneme-ai
title: Mneme
description: The memory layer of your codebase. Indexes git history + code + decisions, exposes them via MCP so AI coding assistants can answer 'why does this code exist?' with real context. Hybrid retrieval (BM25 + cosine + RRF), local-first SQLite, optional Ollama or OpenAI embeddings. MIT licensed.
